title: Words you’ll see in {name}: brain, task, project, skill, routine…
description: What {name}’s own words mean, in a sentence each: brain, Auto, task, project, creation, skill, routine, flow, connection, helper, profile and more.
answer: {name} uses a few words of its own. The one to know first is brain: the AI that writes the answers. The others come as you go, each when {name} first shows what it names.
terms.title: The words, in the order you meet them
terms: Brain
The AI that writes the answers: a service in the cloud, a plan you already pay for, or a brain on this device. {name} itself writes nothing. You choose yours in {settings} › {brains}: see {choose}.
{auto}
How much brain each request gets, chosen for you: a quick one for a quick question, a stronger one for a demanding task, and the one on this device for anything personal, when you have one.
Task
One request and all that follows from it: the answers, the steps {name} took, the files. Each task is in the task list; {new} starts another.
Approvals
What {name} does by itself, asks you first, or never does, for each kind of action: {allow}, {ask} or {never}, in {settings} › {approvals}. See {asks}.
Capability
Something {name} can do, such as reading your files or working out exact figures. Each shows up when a moment calls for it; {settings} › {capabilities} lists them all. See {more}.
Project
Anything you keep coming back to, kept apart from the rest: its own tasks, files, notes and instructions. Its name is at the top of the window.
Creation
Something {name} made that stays in the project, to open and change again: a document, a collection, slides, a design, a picture, a score or an app. Once there is one, they are all under {creations}.
Collection
A list {name} keeps for you in rows and columns, shown as a table or a board: job applications, expenses, books to read.
Skill
How you want one kind of thing done, saved so that {name} does it the same way each time: a weekly report, a letter in your style. Type / in the box to use one by its name.
Routine
A request {name} sends itself on a schedule, every morning for instance, or once later, like a reminder.
Flow
The steps of a task you repeat, drawn one after another, to change and run again.
Connection
A service of yours that {name} may use once you connect it, such as your email, calendar or documents. It reads and acts there only as you allow.
Helper
For a big request in several parts, {name} hands each part to a helper, all working at the same time, inside the task.
Intuition
A small helper on this device that reads each request to choose the right brain and suggest what to do next. Nothing it reads leaves the device.
Profile
Each person on this device has their own: tasks, memory, settings and keys, nothing crossing from one to another. A child’s profile is set by a parent.
Extension
Something added to {name} to do more, such as checking what is sent. Each is kept away from your files and keys, and does only what you allowed.
good: The words are the same on every screen, so a step in this help says what your screen says.
In another language, {name} uses that language’s own words for all of these.
fixes: A word here isn’t on your screen
It comes with a capability you haven’t found yet. {settings} › {capabilities} shows each one, and how it comes.
